answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 14 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 820 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The echo is the check that cannot be faked, the horizon is the price the attacker pays, and the ember is the record that outlives the epoch.
